WITH state_counts AS (
  SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_id) as player_count
  FROM hall_of_fame hof
  INNER JOIN player p ON hof.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY p.death_state
),
above_avg_states AS (
  SELECT sc.player_count
  FROM state_counts sc
  WHERE sc.player_count > (SELECT AVG(player_count) FROM state_counts)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(player_count) as states_avg_count,
  AVG(player_count) - (SELECT AVG(player_count) FROM state_counts) as avg_excess
FROM above_avg_states
